name: Bavarian Tarock
summary: Three-player trick-taking game where declarer bids to play alone against two defenders to score 61+ points.
rules_text: Bavarian Tarock uses 36 German-suited cards ranking A-10-K-O-U-9-8-7-6 (Ace high). 11 cards are dealt to each of 3 players, 3 to the talon (Gstaat) face down. With 4 at table, dealer sits out and rotates. Forehand opens bidding with pass or 'I play'. Next players can overcall with 'I play better' (commit to Solo) and 'I play best' (must play Heart Solo), earlier player may hold. In Frage contracts declarer exchanges 3 cards with talon and discards count for declarer; in Solo contracts talon stays untouched but belongs to declarer. Forehand leads, must follow suit, must trump if void, no need to win trick. Highest of led suit or highest trump wins trick; defenders share one pile. Declarer needs 61 of 120 points to win, 91 for Schneider, all tricks for Durch. Payments from/to pot, doubled for Solo.
rating_reason: Bavarian Tarock trick-taking with German pack, strategic.
